notes:
Review of #33305 (doc-only: seven module docstrings with file references). For every changed module doc I checked whether the new path exists in the reviewed tree, whether that file actually holds what the sentence says it holds, whether the edited lines pass Mathlib's longLine linter (I enabled `linter.style.longLine` with lean_verify_edit, since the plain compile does not turn it on), and whether the same docstring still has other stale references. Proof-golf, generalization, duplication and naming do not apply: no declaration, statement or proof changes.

1. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Abelianization/Defs.lean: `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Grp/Adjunctions.lean` exists (the GrpCat/ path does not), and it defines `GrpCat.abelianize` and `abelianizeAdj`, the adjunction the sentence describes. Line lengths are fine. Nothing to ask.

2. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/FreeAbelianGroup.lean: same new path. It contains `AddCommGrpCat.free` / `AddCommGrpCat.adj`, the adjunction for free abelian groups. Nothing to ask.

3. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/Basic.lean: same new path. It contains `GrpCat.free` / `GrpCat.adj`. The file's other reference (`Mathlib/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/GeneratorEquiv.lean`, line 789) exists. Nothing to ask.

4. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/DomAct/ActionHom.lean: the new target `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Action/Hom.lean` exists but is the wrong file. It holds `Function.Surjective.mulActionLeft` and `MulAction.compHom` and never mentions `MulActionHom`. `α →[N] β` (`MulActionHom`, line 84) and `A →+[N] B` (`DistribMulActionHom`, line 563) are defined in `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/Hom.lean`. That is the successor of the old `Mathlib/Algebra/Hom/GroupAction.lean`, and ActionHom.lean already imports it. That file already has `SMul R (X →ₑ[σ] Y)` and `MulAction R (X →ₑ[σ] Y)` (lines 427 and 464), so half of the TODO is done. Left actions on `A →ₑ+[φ] B` are missing, and so are the left/right `SMulCommClass` instances: DomAct has only `SMulCommClass Mᵈᵐᵃ M'ᵈᵐᵃ`. A corrected line (94 characters) compiles and passes longLine. Finding filed.

5. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Defs.lean: the edited bullet is fine. `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Abelian.lean` really does not exist, so 'planned file' is accurate, and line 49 is 99 characters, so it passes longLine. The very next bullet (line 52), in the same TODO block, still points to `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean`. That is now a `deprecated_module (since := "2025-06-14")` stub. The H2 / group-extensions TODO now lives in `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Homological/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean` (TODO at line 50). This is the same kind of stale ref the PR is fixing. The rewrapped fix compiles and passes longLine. Finding filed. The other references in the file (`GroupExtension/Basic.lean`, `Equiv.ofMonoidHom`) resolve.

6. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Perm/Sign.lean: `Mathlib/GroupTheory/Perm/Finite.lean` exists (Perm/Fintype.lean does not). Its title is 'Permutations on `Fintype`s' and it holds the miscellaneous Perm lemmas that the porting-era note means, so the ref is now correct. The sentence is changelog-style and has no final period, but I would not hold the PR to that. Nothing to ask.

7. module_doc in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Submonoid/Inverses.lean: `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Submonoid/Units.lean` exists and has the implementation section about the units-like constructions (the heading there is 'Implementation details'). The edited line 23 is now 101 characters. With `linter.style.longLine` enabled it warns 'This line exceeds the 100 character limit', which fails Mathlib's lint CI. Moving 'details' to the next line fixes it (verified). Finding filed. The same docstring also names `IsUnit.Submonoid M`, which does not exist (the declaration is `IsUnit.submonoid`, and the file uses it at line 41). It also writes `leftInvEquiv : S.leftInv ≃* S` while every other mention uses `N`. Since this PR is a docstring-reference fix touching this docstring, I filed an advisory finding for these. The `Pointwise.lean` reference resolves.

Elsewhere in GroupTheory, the only file reference that does not resolve to a live module is the LowDegree one in finding 2 (the `Abelian.lean` reference is intentionally 'planned'). The stale `GrpCat/` refs in `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Grp/{Injective,EnoughInjectives}.lean` are outside this PR's GroupTheory scope, so I did not ask for them.

findings.claim: The module doc of ActionHom.lean now points its TODO at `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Action/Hom.lean`, which is the wrong file. That file holds `MulAction.compHom` and `Function.Surjective.mulActionLeft` and does not know `MulActionHom` at all. `α →[N] β` / `A →+[N] B` (`MulActionHom`, `DistribMulActionHom`) are defined in `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/Hom.lean`, the successor of the old `Mathlib/Algebra/Hom/GroupAction.lean` and the file ActionHom.lean imports. So the 'fix' replaces one stale reference with an incorrect one.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the TODO to `Add left actions of, e.g., `M` on `α →[N] β` to `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/Hom.lean` and` (94 characters; compiles and passes longLine). Also, since that file already provides `SMul R (X →ₑ[σ] Y)` / `MulAction R (X →ₑ[σ] Y)`, narrow the TODO to the parts still missing: left actions on `A →+[N] B`, and the `SMulCommClass` instances between the left actions and the `Mᵈᵐᵃ` actions.

findings.claim: In the module doc of Inverses.lean, the edited line `in `N`. See the implementation notes of `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Submonoid/Units.lean` for more details` is 101 characters. With `linter.style.longLine` enabled (as in Mathlib CI) it warns 'This line exceeds the 100 character limit', so the PR fails the style lint.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrap the paragraph so 'details' starts the next line: `in `N`. See the implementation notes of `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Submonoid/Units.lean` for more` / `details on related constructions.` (verified: no longLine warning).

findings.claim: The module doc of GroupExtension/Defs.lean still has a stale file reference in the same TODO block this PR edits. `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean` is now a `deprecated_module (since := "2025-06-14")` stub. The H2/group-extensions TODO it cites now lives in `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Homological/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean`.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the reference and rewrap to stay within 100 characters: `  (which is also stated as a TODO in` / `  `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Homological/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean`).` (verified to compile with longLine enabled).

findings.claim: The module doc of Inverses.lean, which this PR edits to fix references, still names a declaration that does not exist: `IsUnit.Submonoid M`. The declaration is `IsUnit.submonoid`, and the file itself uses `IsUnit.submonoid M` at line 41. The same paragraph also switches from `N` to `S` in `leftInvEquiv : S.leftInv ≃* S`.
findings.suggested_fix: Write `When `N ≤ IsUnit.submonoid M`` and `leftInvEquiv : N.leftInv ≃* N`, so the docstring names a real declaration and uses one variable throughout.
